import json

seq = "( { < { ( ( { } ) ( ) ) } { } < { } > < > > } { } ( { ( { { } } ) [ ( ) ] } ) ) [ ( [ ]"
closer_to_opener = {")": "(", "]": "[", "}": "{", ">": "<"}
opener_to_closer = {v: k for k, v in closer_to_opener.items()}

tokens = seq.split()
stack = []
valid = True
max_depth = 0
first_error_index = None

for i, t in enumerate(tokens):
    if t in opener_to_closer:
        stack.append(t)
        max_depth = max(max_depth, len(stack))
    elif t in closer_to_opener:
        if not stack or stack[-1] != closer_to_opener[t]:
            valid = False
            first_error_index = i
            break
        stack.pop()
    else:
        valid = False
        first_error_index = i
        break

if not valid:
    final_answer = "UNSUPPORTED"
else:
    final_answer = "".join(opener_to_closer[t] for t in reversed(stack))

evidence = {
    "tokens_processed": len(tokens) if first_error_index is None else first_error_index,
    "prefix_valid": valid,
    "max_stack_depth": max_depth,
    "unclosed_openers_bottom_to_top": stack,
    "completion_length": len(final_answer) if final_answer != "UNSUPPORTED" else 0,
}

print(json.dumps({"final_answer": final_answer, "evidence": evidence}, separators=(",", ":")))
